summary: The Alabama Board of Nursing suffered a ransomware attack. A forensic investigation found suspicious server activity beginning in August 2026 and continuing through September 1, 2026, after which systems were taken offline and online nurse licensing services were disrupted. The Board said data downloaded from the environment could include licensee names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, professional licensing information and medical information. The FBI and ALEA were notified.
